{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
df_clean['status'].value_counts()"}
